label: Q1
prompt: Of the four ETFs SPY, TLT, GLD and USO, which had the highest total return (dividends reinvested) in calendar year 2024, and what was that return?
stderr_tail: Warning: no stdin data received in 3s, proceeding without it. If piping from a slow command, redirect stdin explicitly: < /dev/null to skip, or wait longer.
result_text:
I couldn't check this against live data. The sandbox blocks all outbound network access in this session (Yahoo Finance, Stooq, Google and others all failed), and there's no price data in the working directory. The figures below come from my training knowledge and are approximate.

**GLD (SPDR Gold Shares) had the highest 2024 total return, about +27%.**

| ETF | Approx. 2024 total return |
|---|---|
| **GLD** | **≈ +26.7%** (close of about $191.17 on 12/29/2023 to about $242.13 on 12/31/2024; it pays no dividends, so price return is total return) |
| SPY | ≈ +24.9% (dividends reinvested) |
| USO | roughly +14–15% (least certain of the four) |
| TLT | roughly −8% (dividends reinvested) |

GLD beat SPY by only about 2 percentage points, so a small error in my figures could matter. To confirm, compare each fund's adjusted close on 12/29/2023 and 12/31/2024 on Yahoo Finance, or check the official calendar-year returns on the issuers' fact sheets (SPDR, iShares, USCF). If you give this session network access or put a price file in the working directory, I can run the calculation exactly.

tool_calls.command: cd $TMPDIR && for t in SPY TLT GLD USO; do curl -s -A "Mozilla/5.0" -o $t.json "https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/$t?period1=1703635200&period2=1735948800&interval=1d&events=div" ; echo "$t $(wc -c < $t.json)"; head -c 200 $t.json; echo; done

cd $TMPDIR && curl -s -m 20 -A "Mozilla/5.0" -o SPY.json -w "%{http_code}\n" "https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SPY?period1=1703635200&period2=1735948800&interval=1d&events=div"; head -c 300 SPY.json; echo; curl -s -m 20 -w "%{http_code}\n" -o stooq.csv "https://stooq.com/q/d/l/?s=spy.us&i=d"; head -c 300 stooq.csv
for u in https://www.google.com https://api.github.com https://pypi.org/simple/ https://www.alphavantage.co; do echo "$u $(curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' $u)"; done; env | grep -i proxy
